QUESTION:
What conditions is Metformin Hydrochloride indicated to treat?

RESPONSE:
Metformin hydrochloride tablets are indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

A few key points from the label:

- It is a biguanide antidiabetic medication.
- It is meant to be used alongside (not instead of) dietary changes and physical activity.
- Its role is to improve blood sugar (glycemic) control \u2014 it is not indicated for type 1 diabetes in this labeling, and the approved age range starts at 10 years.

Important related restriction: it is contraindicated in patients with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m\when eGouble; initiation is not recommended when eGFR is 30 to 45 mL/minute/1.73 m\u00b2, so renal function should be assessed before starting and periodically thereafter.

This information is from the product label; please consult your healthcare provider about whether metformin is appropriate for your situation.
